critique: Best of the three: neon teal-on-plum grade cohesive and moody, dense falling field, slight smears on some particles — but the drops still read as dots, not 雨丝 streaks. Aspect ratio (0524) produced no clear elongation in either direction at this scale; motion-blur smear stays sub-perceptual. Max-iters reached. Residue is a rendering-class finding: the streak read needs an aspect/orientation probe (0524 semantics unresolved) or the streaklet/motion-blur mode combination the vendor rain thumbs use.
